LanguageData.MAP_PsychicActivation.label: Psychic activation
LanguageData.MAP_PsychicActivation.description: Actively stimulate the psychic core, briefly bringing psychic pathways into a highly active state.\nDuring this period, the user's psychic abilities are further enhanced, with additional psyfocus recovery.\nThe additional recovery increases with psychic core level. Lasts six hours.
LanguageData.MAP_BattlefieldRepairProtocol.label: Battlefield repair protocol
LanguageData.MAP_BattlefieldRepairProtocol.descriptio: Activate the battlefield repair protocol, overloading the guidance of mechanoid self-repair to provide powerful self-repair effects to all overseen mechanoids. The mechanitor's consciousness is reduced as the cost of this divided attention.
